info.title: AWS AppSync data-plane supplement
info.description: The one operation the AWS smithy model does not declare but the mirror serves: the GraphQL query endpoint, answered over the AWSJSON11 target AWSAppSync.GraphQL. It rides X-Amz-Target dispatch like every other AppSync operation, so the path item is the service root. Fused into aws.appsync by x-mirror-service; the smithy document keeps every other operation, its protocol and its shapes.

post.summary: Run a GraphQL query against an API (emulator echo semantics)
